challenge: Travel day to New York: no gym or dumbbells, so keep it light — walk the airport instead of sitting, a short hotel-room bodyweight set, and an easy city walk. Yellow recovery (43%) after a short night (sleep 48%), so easy pace only.
constraint: 9:45 AM ET flight from ORD; New Buffalo rain until ~1 PM, high near 47; NYC ~49°F, breezy, chance of showers after 1 PM
items: Walk the terminal 15–20 min before boarding (skip the moving walkways)
Stand and stretch calves and hips on the plane every hour
Easy 30 min city walk in NYC (bring a jacket; showers possible after 1 PM)
